text:
CLASSIFICATION::result
Description
This command provides classification results.
Syntax
CLASSIFICATION
::
result
Examples
#In the example, the CLASSIFICATION::result command returns an array of classification tokens.
when
CLASSIFICATION_DETECTED
{
set
res
[
CLASSIFICATION
::
result
]
log
local0.debug
"DPI results: $res"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
CLASSIFICATION_DETECTED
